characters.name: Priya
characters.appearance: Young adult woman with a slim build and fair complexion. She has dark hair tied back in a ponytail and subtle facial features.
characters.wardrobe: She wears a light blue t-shirt. Initially, she is also wearing a black jacket which she takes off.
characters.demeanor: Expressive, curious, and eager to learn.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Female-presenting humanoid robot with a white and silver metallic body showing visible joints. The face is human-like with pale skin and dark eyes.

scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: What are you doing? I am removing my jacket.
Miss Nova says: Removing? Are you deleting it permanently? For clothes, we say 'taking off'. Try saying, 'I am taking off my jacket'.
Priya says: I am taking off my jacket. Oh, I always freeze when I have to speak English.
Miss Nova says: That's normal! I am Miss Nova. On Supernova AI, I don't give everyone the same lessons. I analyze your level and build a personalized plan just for you.
Priya says: But what if I make mistakes?
Miss Nova says: Make a thousand mistakes at 3 a.m.! I will correct you without ever judging or laughing.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Relatable Indian-English error ('removing' vs 'taking off').
- Payload a: Personalization (analyzes level, builds plan).
- Payload b: Privacy/no-judgement (make 1000 mistakes, no laughing).
